name: plantuml-diagrams
title: PlantUML
description: Draw PlantUML diagrams in issues, comments and Knowledge Base articles. Insert a PlantUML block from the editor toolbar and type the diagram source. The diagram is rendered in your browser: the source is not sent to a server. C4 diagrams are supported. In projects that the app is attached to, ```plantuml code blocks are replaced with diagrams when the text is saved.
